root_cause: The datepicker component's initialization causes the Vanilla Calendar Pro library to attach a keydown listener to the departure input that prevents the Tab keypress, blocking focus movement to the next field.
repair_strategy: Wrap the departure input in a div with class 'form-adorn' so the datepicker positions the calendar relative to the div rather than the input. This prevents VCP from attaching the problematic keydown listener to the input, allowing normal Tab behavior.

edits.before:
<label class="form-label" for="departure">Departure date</label>
    <input class="form-control mb-3" id="departure" name="departure" value="2026-10-22" data-bs-toggle="datepicker" autocomplete="off">

expected_accessibility_effect: Tab key will move focus from the departure date field to the passengers field as expected, restoring logical tab order in the form.
functional_risks: Calendar positioning may shift slightly due to the wrapper div, though the form-adorn class is intended for this purpose.
Label association remains intact via the input's id attribute.
Regression guards for Escape (calendar close) and click (calendar open) should remain functional as the input still triggers the datepicker.
verification_requirements: Pressing Tab from the departure field must focus the passengers field.
The calendar must still open when the departure field receives focus.
Pressing Escape must close the calendar if open.
Clicking the departure field must still show the calendar.
